name: Rábaszentmiklós (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a serrated stripe of red and green triangles along each side edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rábaszentmiklós: a red and blue shield with a saint, a church and an ox, above a scroll inscribed RÁBASZENTMIKLÓS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
